title: Minimal Graph IR candidate and read-only X6 viewer spike
objective: Generate a deterministic Graph IR candidate from Nx and coordination state, then render it through a generic X6 wrapper with editing disabled.
blockers: The in-app browser reported no available browser instances, so read-only interaction and runtime rendering could not be accepted in a real browser.
risks: The candidate schema is spike evidence and must not be mistaken for the accepted Graph IR v1 of I-002.
The new X6 dependency must be pinned, licensed, and supply-chain checked.
